en.name: Dumbledore
en.ability: If you are killed at night, pick a player. They learn who you were. If they are evil, they are drunk the following day and next night.

revisions.v1: If you are killed at night, pick a player. They learn who you were. If they are evil, they are drunk the following day and next night.

en.flavor: Curiosity is not a sin. But we should exercise caution with our curiosity... yes, indeed.
en.otherNightReminder: Wake if killed and ask to pick a player
